enabled.description: Master switch; when false every heal call reports DISABLED and takes no action.

auto_reconcile.description: Refresh the GitHub snapshot and reconciliation whenever they are stale, exactly as the operator's step 2 would.

auto_redispatch.description: Issue a fresh dispatcher release after healing actions invalidate the pinned one.

break_expired_validation_lease.description: Archive an EXPIRED global validation lease left by a dead session; a live lease is never touched.

claim_stall_minutes.description: A live remote claim with zero work commits for this long is treated as a dead worker's and retired (force-with-lease guards the race).

branch_stall_minutes.description: An unsealed work branch idle this long, whose governing claim is expired or absent, is archived under refs/hive-mind-autopilot/quarantine/ and its branch ref retired.

max_actions_per_run.description: Upper bound on remote repairs a single heal pass may apply; the rest are reported as DEFERRED.
